title: Remove Diagnostics tail helper flat exports
summary: Removed three Diagnostics parent transitional flat window assignments for tail helper functions while preserving the namespace exports and regenerating WebView contract/inventory evidence.
reason: Continue the opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup in the already touched Diagnostics domain without changing backend authority, media policy, mutation routes, or Diagnostics runtime behavior.
behavior_before: diagnosticsView.js assigned selectedDiagnosticsTailMaxBytes, setDiagnosticsTailStatus, and setDiagnosticsTailBusy onto window as transitional flat compatibility exports, even though window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView already exposed those helpers.
behavior_after: diagnosticsView.js exposes selectedDiagnosticsTailMaxBytes, setDiagnosticsTailStatus, and setDiagnosticsTailBusy through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView only; intentional bridge/open/tail flat hooks remain unchanged.
tests_added: Extended tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api.LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert the Diagnostics namespace exports remain present and the removed tail helper flat assignments are absent.
rollback_plan: Re-add the removed Diagnostics flat assignments, regenerate the WebView contract/inventory/summaries, and remove the corresponding negative static assertions if an intentional compatibility consumer is discovered.
